title: Coca-Cola Bottle Zoom Out
creative_brief: The video starts with an extreme close-up of a hand gripping a classic glass Coca-Cola bottle. The camera slowly zooms out to reveal a young woman enjoying the drink in a relaxed, sunlit environment.
global_visual_style: Cinematic, high-definition, realistic lighting, shallow depth of field transitioning to medium depth, vibrant colors, commercial aesthetic.
overall_soundscape: The sound of ice clinking in the bottle, the fizz of carbonation, and a soft, refreshing ambient background noise.
non_diegetic_music: A light, upbeat, and refreshing instrumental track that builds gently as the camera zooms out.
constraints: Maintain consistent lighting and character appearance throughout the zoom. Ensure the Coca-Cola branding is clear and accurate. The zoom movement should be smooth and steady.
theme_text: A cinematic close-up of a hand holding a Coca-Cola bottle, slowly zooming out to reveal a young woman drinking it in a bright, modern setting.

shots.framing: Extreme close-up transitioning to medium shot
shots.subject_action: A hand holds a glass Coca-Cola bottle. As the camera zooms out, it reveals a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a casual white t-shirt, taking a sip from the bottle. She smiles slightly, enjoying the drink.
shots.environment_response: The background is a bright, modern café or living room with soft natural light streaming in. The environment remains static but becomes more visible as the camera zooms out.
shots.additional_direction: Focus on the condensation on the bottle and the clarity of the liquid. The transition from close-up to medium shot should be seamless, maintaining the subject's focus.
